none: PAS LIN-083B33: LIN-083B33: Roman radiate of Gallienus
contea di ritrovamento: Derbyshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman radiate of Gallienus (270-68). GERMANICVS MAX V (or MAXIMVS) reverse depicting two captives either side of a trophy. AD 253-268. Unknown mint. Oval shaped - perhaps a contemporary copy. Obverse inscription: GALLIENVS P AVG. Obverse description: Radiate and cuirassed bust right. Reverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: Trophy of arms, with seated captive on either side. Measurements: 20.90 x 19.24mm, Weight: 2.18g
